response.sql:
WITH rating_ratios AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS films
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT rating, ratio, films, AVG(ratio) OVER () AS plain_average
  FROM rating_ratios
)
SELECT rating, ratio, films, ratio - plain_average AS difference_from_average
FROM with_average;

assumptions.assumption: The plain average is the unweighted average of the per-rating ratios, giving each rating equal weight; each rating's ratio is the average of film-level rental_rate / replacement_cost values, with SQL AVG ignoring NULL ratios.
